subject: Celestia native nucleus illustration and catalog scale
finding: Superseded 2026-09-16: the Celestia generic mesh was a shared illustration with no relation to this nucleus, and its catalogue radius was an estimate. The package now shows a smooth ellipsoid at the published effective radius (no published measurement); no mesh from Celestia is retained.
revisitWhen: A measured shape model of this nucleus (radar, spacecraft or a convex lightcurve inversion with a stated pole) would replace the ellipsoid.
